description: Header file defining the Python binding and internal structure for torch.autograd.Variable, including functions for wrapping, checking, and unpacking tensor objects, as well as related utility functions.

classes.name: THPVariable
classes.description: Python object backing torch.autograd.Variable, containing tensor data and hooks.

methods.name: registerPythonTensorClass
methods.description: Registers a Python tensor class for a specific device.

methods.name: activateGPUTrace
methods.description: Activates GPU tracing for debugging or profiling.

methods.name: THPVariable_Wrap
methods.description: Wraps a tensor into a Python object.

methods.name: THPVariable_WrapList
methods.description: Wraps a list of tensors into a Python list of Python objects.

methods.name: THPVariable_Unpack
methods.description: Unpacks a Python object to retrieve the underlying tensor.

methods.name: parseIValuesToPyArgsKwargs
methods.description: Converts operator handle and IValues to Python args and kwargs.

methods.name: pushPyOutToStack
methods.description: Pushes a Python object output to the JIT stack.

methods.name: get_dtensor_class
methods.description: Retrieves the Python class for DTensor.

methods.name: dispatchDTensorOp
methods.description: Dispatches a DTensor operation with given operator handle and arguments.
